<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Shadow Chat</title>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

<!-- Firebase (compat SDK — works with plain <script> tags, no build step, GitHub Pages / jsDelivr / Neocities friendly) -->
<script src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.13.0/firebase-app-compat.js"></script>
<script src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.13.0/firebase-database-compat.js"></script>

<style>
  :root{
    --bg-black:#0a0a0d;
    --bg-deep:#111015;
    --shadow-purple:#5b3a8e;
    --shadow-violet:#8b5cf6;
    --shadow-glow:#a78bfa;
    --ember:#ff5252;
    --good:#7CFC9A;
    --gold:#e0b95c;
    --text-light:#e9e6f5;
    --text-dim:#8b8797;
    --panel:#15131a;
    --panel-border:#2b2635;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html,body{
    margin:0;padding:0;height:100%;
    background:var(--bg-black);
    font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
    color:var(--text-light);
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  #app{position:relative;width:100%;height:100vh;overflow:hidden;}

  /* ---- fog background ---- */
  .fog-layer{
    position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;
    background:
      radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 40% at 20% 20%, rgba(91,58,142,0.35), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 50% at 80% 70%, rgba(139,92,246,0.18), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 50% at 50% 100%, rgba(20,10,30,0.9), transparent 70%),
      linear-gradient(180deg, #0a0a0d 0%, #120f18 60%, #0a0a0d 100%);
    animation:drift 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }
  @keyframes drift{
    0%{background-position:0% 0%, 0% 0%, 0% 0%, 0 0;}
    100%{background-position:5% 8%, -6% -4%, 0% 0%, 0 0;}
  }
  .shadow-blob{
    position:absolute;border-radius:50%;
    filter:blur(60px);opacity:0.35;pointer-events:none;
    background:radial-gradient(circle, var(--shadow-violet), transparent 70%);
    animation:float 12s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes float{
    0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) translateX(0);}
    50%{transform:translateY(-30px) translateX(20px);}
  }

  ::-webkit-scrollbar{width:8px;}
  ::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:transparent;}
  ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--panel-border);border-radius:10px;}

  /* ---- auth screen ---- */
  #authScreen{
    position:relative;z-index:2;height:100%;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    flex-direction:column;text-align:center;padding:20px;
  }
  .logo{
    font-family:'Cinzel',serif;
    font-size:clamp(2.2rem,6vw,3.4rem);
    font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;
    color:var(--text-light);
    text-shadow:0 0 20px var(--shadow-glow), 0 0 60px var(--shadow-purple);
    margin-bottom:6px;
  }
  .tagline{color:var(--text-dim);margin-bottom:34px;font-size:0.95rem;letter-spacing:0.5px;}
  .auth-card{
    width:100%;max-width:360px;background:var(--panel);
    border:1px solid var(--panel-border);
    border-radius:16px;padding:28px 26px 32px;
    box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(139,92,246,0.12), inset 0 0 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
    backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
  }
  .tabs{display:flex;margin-bottom:22px;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--panel-border);}
  .tab-btn{
    flex:1;padding:10px 0;background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text-dim);
    font-family:'Inter';font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.9rem;transition:all .2s;
  }
  .tab-btn.active{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--shadow-purple),var(--shadow-violet));color:#fff;}
  .field{margin-bottom:16px;text-align:left;}
  .field label{display:block;font-size:0.78rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin-bottom:6px;letter-spacing:0.4px;}
  .field input{
    width:100%;padding:11px 13px;border-radius:9px;
    background:#0d0c11;border:1px solid var(--panel-border);
    color:var(--text-light);font-size:0.95rem;outline:none;transition:border .2s;
  }
  .field input:focus{border-color:var(--shadow-violet);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(139,92,246,0.15);}
  .primary-btn{
    width:100%;padding:12px;border:none;border-radius:9px;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--shadow-purple),var(--shadow-violet));
    color:#fff;font-weight:600;font-size:0.95rem;cursor:pointer;
    box-shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(139,92,246,0.35);
    transition:transform .15s, box-shadow .15s;margin-top:4px;
  }
  .primary-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(139,92,246,0.5);}
  .primary-btn:active{transform:translateY(0);}
  .primary-btn:disabled{opacity:0.6;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none;}
  .ghost-btn{
    width:100%;padding:10px;border-radius:9px;margin-top:8px;
    background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--panel-border);color:var(--text-dim);
    font-weight:600;font-size:0.85rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;
  }
  .ghost-btn:hover{border-color:var(--text-dim);color:var(--text-light);}
  .auth-msg{min-height:18px;font-size:0.82rem;color:var(--ember);margin-top:10px;word-break:break-word;}

  .yt-banner{
    margin-top:26px;max-width:360px;width:100%;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,0,0,0.08), rgba(139,92,246,0.08));
    border:1px solid var(--panel-border);border-radius:12px;
    padding:14px 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;
    text-decoration:none;color:var(--text-light);
    transition:border-color .2s, transform .15s;
  }
  .yt-banner:hover{border-color:#ff5252;transform:translateY(-1px);}
  .yt-icon{
    width:34px;height:34px;flex:0 0 auto;border-radius:8px;
    background:#ff2d2d;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(255,45,45,0.5);
  }
  .yt-icon svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:#fff;}
  .yt-text{text-align:left;line-height:1.3;}
  .yt-text b{font-size:0.88rem;}
  .yt-text span{font-size:0.75rem;color:var(--text-dim);}

  /* ---- chat screen ---- */
  #chatScreen{
    position:relative;z-index:2;height:100%;display:none;
    flex-direction:row;max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;
    padding:16px 16px 0;gap:14px;
  }

  /* ---- avatars ---- */
  .avatar{
    border-radius:50%;flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    font-weight:700;color:#fff;overflow:hidden;background:var(--shadow-purple);
  }
  .avatar img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
  .avatar-xs{width:20px;height:20px;font-size:0.6rem;}
  .avatar-sm{width:28px;height:28px;font-size:0.72rem;}
  .avatar-md{width:38px;height:38px;font-size:0.85rem;}
  .presence-dot{
    width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;flex:0 0 auto;border:2px solid var(--bg-black);
    background:var(--text-dim);
  }
  .presence-dot.online{background:var(--good);}

  /* ---- sidebar ---- */
  #sidebar{
    width:250px;flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
    border-right:1px solid var(--panel-border);padding-right:14px;
    min-height:0;
  }
  #sidebar.collapsed{display:none;}

  .general-nav-btn{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 10px;border-radius:9px;
    cursor:pointer;font-size:0.86rem;color:var(--text-dim);transition:all .15s;
    border:1px solid var(--panel-border);margin:8px 0 6px;background:var(--panel);
  }
  .general-nav-btn:hover{color:var(--text-light);}
  .general-nav-btn.active{
    background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(91,58,142,0.35), rgba(139,92,246,0.2));
    border-color:rgba(139,92,246,0.35);color:#fff;
  }

  .voice-status-bar{
    display:none;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:9px;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(124,252,154,0.12), rgba(139,92,246,0.1));
    border:1px solid rgba(124,252,154,0.35);font-size:0.76rem;color:var(--good);margin-bottom:8px;
  }
  .voice-status-bar.show{display:flex;}
  .voice-status-bar span.vname{flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}
  .voice-status-bar button{
    background:transparent;border:1px solid rgba(255,82,82,0.4);color:var(--ember);
    border-radius:6px;font-size:0.68rem;padding:2px 7px;cursor:pointer;
  }

  .sidebar-tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;margin:6px 0 10px;}
  .sidebar-tab-btn{
    flex:1;padding:8px 0;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--panel-border);
    background:transparent;color:var(--text-dim);font-weight:600;font-size:0.78rem;
    cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;letter-spacing:0.2px;
  }
  .sidebar-tab-btn.active{
    background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(91,58,142,0.5), rgba(139,92,246,0.3));
    border-color:var(--shadow-violet);color:#fff;
  }
  .sidebar-tab-btn .badge-dot{
    display:inline-block;min-width:16px;height:16px;line-height:16px;
    background:var(--ember);color:#fff;border-radius:8px;font-size:0.62rem;
    margin-left:4px;padding:0 4px;
  }
  .sidebar-section-title{
    font-size:0.68rem;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--text-dim);margin:12px 0 6px;padding:0 4px;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  }
  .new-group-btn{
    background:transparent;border:1px dashed var(--panel-border);color:var(--shadow-glow);
    border-radius:6px;font-size:0.72rem;padding:2px 8px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;
  }
  .new-group-btn:hover{border-color:var(--shadow-violet);background:rgba(139,92,246,0.08);}
  .add-friend-row{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:6px;}
  .add-friend-row input{
    flex:1;padding:8px 11px;border-radius:8px;
    background:#0d0c11;border:1px solid var(--panel-border);
    color:var(--text-light);font-size:0.82rem;outline:none;font-family:'Inter';
  }
  .add-friend-row input:focus{border-color:var(--shadow-violet);}
  .add-friend-row button{
    border:none;border-radius:8px;padding:0 12px;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.78rem;font-weight:600;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--shadow-purple),var(--shadow-violet));color:#fff;
  }
  .add-friend-msg{font-size:0.74rem;min-height:16px;margin:2px 2px 6px;color:var(--ember);}
  .add-friend-msg.ok{color:var(--good);}

  #panelScroll{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding-bottom:10px;}
  .empty-list-note{color:var(--text-dim);font-size:0.78rem;padding:10px 6px;text-align:center;}

  .list-item{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 9px;border-radius:9px;
    cursor:pointer;font-size:0.86rem;color:var(--text-dim);transition:all .15s;
    border:1px solid transparent;margin-bottom:4px;
  }
  .list-item:hover{background:var(--panel);color:var(--text-light);}
  .list-item.active{
    background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(91,58,142,0.35), rgba(139,92,246,0.2));
    border-color:rgba(139,92,246,0.35);color:#fff;
  }
  .list-item .item-name{flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}
  .list-item .hash{opacity:0.5;}
  .list-item .mini-btn{
    opacity:0;background:transparent;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.82rem;padding:0 3px;line-height:1;
  }
  .list-item:hover .mini-btn{opacity:0.9;}
  .list-item .mini-btn.call{color:var(--good);}
  .list-item .mini-btn.video{color:var(--shadow-glow);}
  .list-item .mini-btn.del, .list-item .mini-btn.block{color:var(--ember);}
  .list-item .mini-btn.nick{color:var(--gold);}
  .list-item .voice-count{font-size:0.68rem;color:var(--good);white-space:nowrap;}

  .request-row{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:9px;
    font-size:0.82rem;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--panel-border);margin-bottom:6px;
  }
  .request-row .req-name{flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--text-light);}
  .request-row button{border:none;border-radius:7px;padding:5px 9px;font-size:0.74rem;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;}
  .req-accept{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1f5c34,#2f9451);color:#fff;}
  .req-decline, .req-cancel, .req-unblock{background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--panel-border);color:var(--text-dim);}
  .req-decline:hover, .req-cancel:hover{border-color:var(--ember);color:var(--ember);}
  .req-unblock:hover{border-color:var(--good);color:var(--good);}

  /* ---- main chat column ---- */
  #chatMain{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;}

  .chat-header{
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
    padding:8px 4px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--panel-border);
    gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  }
  .chat-header .header-left{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-width:0;}
  .sidebar-toggle-btn{
    display:none;background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--panel-border);color:var(--text-dim);
    border-radius:8px;padding:6px 9px;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.9rem;
  }
  .chat-header .logo{font-size:1.5rem;margin:0;text-align:left;}
  .current-chat-label-wrap{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;}
  .current-chat-label{font-size:0.85rem;color:var(--shadow-glow);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;}
  .current-chat-sub{font-size:0.68rem;color:var(--text-dim);white-space:nowrap;}
  .header-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .call-header-btn{
    background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--panel-border);color:var(--good);
    padding:6px 11px;border-radius:20px;font-size:0.82rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;
  }
  .call-header-btn:hover{border-color:var(--good);}
  .call-header-btn.video{color:var(--shadow-glow);}
  .call-header-btn.video:hover{border-color:var(--shadow-glow);}
  .my-profile-btn{background:none;border:none;padding:0;cursor:pointer;}
  .user-pill{
    background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--panel-border);
    padding:5px 12px 5px 5px;border-radius:20px;font-size:0.82rem;color:var(--shadow-glow);
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;
  }
  .admin-badge{
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,#3a2e0f,#7a5b12);border:1px solid var(--gold);color:var(--gold);
    padding:5px 10px;border-radius:20px;font-size:0.72rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.5px;
  }
  .conn-pill{padding:6px 12px;border-radius:20px;font-size:0.72rem;border:1px solid var(--panel-border);color:var(--text-dim);}
  .conn-pill.online{color:#7CFC9A;border-color:rgba(124,252,154,0.3);}
  .conn-pill.offline{color:var(--ember);border-color:rgba(255,82,82,0.3);}
  .logout-btn{
    background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--panel-border);color:var(--text-dim);
    padding:6px 12px;border-radius:20px;font-size:0.8rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;
  }
  .logout-btn:hover{border-color:var(--ember);color:var(--ember);}

  .promo-strip{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
    background:linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,45,45,0.10), rgba(139,92,246,0.10));
    border:1px solid var(--panel-border);border-radius:10px;
    padding:9px 14px;margin:10px 0;font-size:0.82rem;color:var(--text-dim);flex-wrap:wrap;
  }
  .promo-strip a{color:var(--shadow-glow);font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;}
  .promo-strip a:hover{text-decoration:underline;}

  /* ---- voice channel panel (inside group chats) ---- */
  .voice-panel{
    display:none;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;
    padding:10px 12px;margin:0 0 10px;border-radius:10px;
    background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--panel-border);
  }
  .voice-panel.show{display:flex;}
  .voice-panel .voice-join-btn{
    border:none;border-radius:18px;padding:6px 14px;font-size:0.8rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1f5c34,#2f9451);color:#fff;
  }
  .voice-panel .voice-join-btn.leave{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#7a1f1f,var(--ember));}
  .voice-chip{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:#0d0c11;border:1px solid var(--panel-border);
    border-radius:16px;padding:4px 10px 4px 4px;font-size:0.76rem;color:var(--text-light);
  }
  .voice-chip .mic-state{font-size:0.72rem;}

  #messages{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:6px 4px 6px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;}
  .msg{max-width:78%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;position:relative;}
  .msg.me{align-self:flex-end;align-items:flex-end;}
  .msg.other{align-self:flex-start;align-items:flex-start;}
  .msg .bubble-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;}
  .msg .bubble{
    padding:9px 14px;border-radius:14px;font-size:0.92rem;line-height:1.4;
    word-wrap:break-word;white-space:pre-wrap;
  }
  .msg.me .bubble{
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--shadow-purple),var(--shadow-violet));
    color:#fff;border-bottom-right-radius:4px;box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(139,92,246,0.3);
  }
  .msg.other .bubble{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--panel-border);border-bottom-left-radius:4px;}
  .msg .meta{font-size:0.68rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin:4px 6px 0;}
  .msg .name-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-bottom:2px;}
  .msg-del-btn, .msg-block-btn{
    background:transparent;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.8rem;opacity:0.6;padding:2px 4px;
  }
  .msg-del-btn{color:var(--ember);}
  .msg-block-btn{color:var(--text-dim);}
  .msg-del-btn:hover, .msg-block-btn:hover{opacity:1;}

  #typingBar{min-height:20px;padding:0 6px;font-size:0.76rem;color:var(--text-dim);font-style:italic;}

  #composer{display:flex;gap:10px;padding:10px 4px 18px;border-top:1px solid var(--panel-border);}
  #msgInput{
    flex:1;padding:12px 15px;border-radius:24px;
    background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--panel-border);
    color:var(--text-light);font-size:0.94rem;outline:none;font-family:'Inter';
  }
  #msgInput:focus{border-color:var(--shadow-violet);}
  #sendBtn{
    padding:0 20px;border:none;border-radius:24px;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--shadow-purple),var(--shadow-violet));
    color:#fff;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(139,92,246,0.3);
  }
  #sendBtn:disabled{opacity:0.5;cursor:not-allowed;}
  .empty-state{text-align:center;color:var(--text-dim);margin-top:40px;font-size:0.88rem;}
  .empty-state .glyph{font-size:2.2rem;display:block;margin-bottom:10px;opacity:0.6;}

  /* ---- modal overlay ---- */
  .modal-overlay{
    position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10;background:rgba(5,4,8,0.72);
    display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;backdrop-filter:blur(3px);
  }
  .modal-overlay.open{display:flex;}
  .modal-card{
    width:100%;max-width:340px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--panel-border);
    border-radius:16px;padding:24px 22px 22px;box-shadow:0 10px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
    text-align:left;max-height:82vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  }
  .modal-card h3{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--text-light);}
  .modal-card p.sub{margin:0 0 16px;font-size:0.78rem;color:var(--text-dim);}
  .modal-card input{
    width:100%;padding:11px 13px;border-radius:9px;
    background:#0d0c11;border:1px solid var(--panel-border);
    color:var(--text-light);font-size:0.95rem;outline:none;margin-bottom:12px;flex:0 0 auto;
  }
  .modal-card input:focus{border-color:var(--shadow-violet);}
  .modal-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:4px;flex:0 0 auto;}
  .modal-actions button{flex:1;}
  .modal-err{min-height:16px;font-size:0.78rem;color:var(--ember);margin:-4px 0 10px;flex:0 0 auto;}
  .member-picker{overflow-y:auto;flex:1;margin-bottom:10px;border-top:1px solid var(--panel-border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--panel-border);padding:8px 0;}
  .member-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:7px 4px;font-size:0.86rem;cursor:pointer;}
  .member-row input{width:auto;margin:0;flex:0 0 auto;}
  .member-row span{flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}

  /* ---- search bar ---- */
  .search-btn{
    background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--panel-border);color:var(--text-dim);
    padding:6px 10px;border-radius:20px;font-size:0.85rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;
  }
  .search-btn:hover{border-color:var(--shadow-violet);color:var(--text-light);}
  .search-btn.active{border-color:var(--shadow-violet);color:var(--shadow-glow);background:rgba(139,92,246,0.1);}
  #searchBar{display:none;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:9px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--panel-border);}
  #searchBar.open{display:flex;}
  #searchInput{
    flex:1;padding:9px 13px;border-radius:20px;
    background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--panel-border);
    color:var(--text-light);font-size:0.88rem;outline:none;font-family:'Inter';
  }
  #searchInput:focus{border-color:var(--shadow-violet);}
  #searchCount{font-size:0.75rem;color:var(--text-dim);white-space:nowrap;min-width:56px;text-align:right;}
  .search-close-btn{background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text-dim);cursor:pointer;font-size:0.95rem;padding:2px 4px;}
  .search-close-btn:hover{color:var(--ember);}
  mark.hl{background:rgba(224,185,92,0.35);color:inherit;border-radius:3px;padding:0 1px;}
  .msg.dimmed{opacity:0.25;}

  /* ---- calling overlays ---- */
  .call-overlay{
    position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:30;background:rgba(4,3,7,0.88);
    display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;
    backdrop-filter:blur(4px);text-align:center;padding:24px;
  }
  .call-overlay.open{display:flex;}
  .call-avatar{
    width:96px;height:96px;border-radius:50%;
    background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, var(--shadow-glow), var(--shadow-purple) 70%);
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:2.1rem;color:#fff;
    animation:pulseRing 1.6s ease-out infinite;margin-bottom:18px;
  }
  @keyframes pulseRing{
    0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(139,92,246,0.55);}
    70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 26px rgba(139,92,246,0);}
    100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(139,92,246,0);}
  }
  .call-peer-name{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:1.4rem;color:var(--text-light);margin-bottom:4px;}
  .call-status-text{color:var(--text-dim);font-size:0.9rem;margin-bottom:26px;}
  .call-btn-row{display:flex;gap:22px;}
  .round-btn{
    width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:50%;border:none;cursor:pointer;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.4rem;transition:transform .15s;
  }
  .round-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .round-btn.accept{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1f5c34,#2f9451);color:#fff;}
  .round-btn.decline, .round-btn.hangup{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#7a1f1f,var(--ember));color:#fff;}
  .round-btn.mute{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--panel-border);color:var(--text-light);}
  .round-btn.mute.active{background:var(--ember);color:#fff;}
  .round-btn.vidtoggle{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--panel-border);color:var(--text-light);}
  .round-btn.vidtoggle.active{background:var(--shadow-violet);color:#fff;}

  #inCallOverlay{justify-content:flex-end;}
  .in-call-videos{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:640px;flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
  #remoteVideoEl{width:100%;max-height:60vh;border-radius:16px;background:#0d0c11;object-fit:cover;border:1px solid var(--panel-border);}
  #localVideoEl{position:absolute;bottom:12px;right:12px;width:110px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--panel-border);background:#0d0c11;object-fit:cover;box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);}
  .in-call-audio-mode #remoteVideoEl, .in-call-audio-mode #localVideoEl{display:none;}
  .call-timer{color:var(--text-dim);font-size:0.82rem;margin:14px 0 18px;}

  @media (max-width: 720px){
    #chatScreen{padding:10px 10px 0;}
    #sidebar{
      position:fixed;top:0;left:0;bottom:0;width:250px;z-index:8;
      background:var(--bg-black);padding:14px 14px 10px;border-right:1px solid var(--panel-border);
      transform:translateX(-100%);transition:transform .2s ease;
    }
    #sidebar.mobile-open{transform:translateX(0);}
    .sidebar-toggle-btn{display:inline-flex;}
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="app">
  <div class="fog-layer"></div>
  <div class="shadow-blob" style="width:280px;height:280px;top:10%;left:8%;"></div>
  <div class="shadow-blob" style="width:220px;height:220px;bottom:8%;right:10%;animation-delay:3s;"></div>

  <!-- AUTH SCREEN -->
  <div id="authScreen">
    <div class="logo">🌑 SHADOW CHAT</div>
    <div class="tagline">Speak freely. The dark keeps your words.</div>

    <div class="auth-card">
      <div class="tabs">
        <button class="tab-btn active" id="tabLogin" onclick="switchTab('login')">Log In</button>
        <button class="tab-btn" id="tabRegister" onclick="switchTab('register')">Create Account</button>
      </div>
      <form id="authForm" onsubmit="handleAuthSubmit(event)">
        <div class="field">
          <label>Username</label>
          <input type="text" id="usernameInput" autocomplete="username" required="" maxlength="20" placeholder="e.g. nightwalker">
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label>Password</label>
          <input type="password" id="passwordInput" autocomplete="current-password" required="" minlength="4" placeholder="••••••••">
        </div>
        <button type="submit" class="primary-btn" id="submitBtn">Enter the Shadows</button>
        <div class="auth-msg" id="authMsg"></div>
      </form>
    </div>

    <a class="yt-banner" href="https://www.youtube.com/@ShadowDefender2" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
      <span class="yt-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7z"></path></svg></span>
      <span class="yt-text"><b>Subscribe to ShadowDefender2</b><br><span>on YouTube — join the crew 🔔</span></span>
    </a>
  </div>

  <!-- CHAT SCREEN -->
  <div id="chatScreen">

    <!-- SIDEBAR -->
    <div id="sidebar">
      <div class="voice-status-bar" id="voiceStatusBar">
        🎙️ <span class="vname" id="voiceStatusName"></span>
        <button onclick="leaveVoiceChannel()">Leave</button>
      </div>

      <div class="general-nav-btn" id="generalNavBtn" onclick="openGeneralChat()">
        <span>🌐</span><span>General</span>
      </div>

      <div class="sidebar-tabs">
        <button class="sidebar-tab-btn active" id="sidebarTabFriends" onclick="switchSidebarTab('friends')">Friends<span class="badge-dot" id="incomingReqBadge" style="display:none;"></span></button>
        <button class="sidebar-tab-btn" id="sidebarTabGroups" onclick="switchSidebarTab('groups')">Groups</button>
      </div>

      <div id="panelScroll">
        <!-- FRIENDS PANEL -->
        <div id="friendsPanel">
          <div class="add-friend-row">
            <input type="text" id="addFriendInput" placeholder="Add friend by username…" maxlength="20" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')sendFriendRequestFromInput()">
            <button onclick="sendFriendRequestFromInput()">Add</button>
          </div>
          <div class="add-friend-msg" id="addFriendMsg"></div>

          <div id="incomingRequestsBlock" style="display:none;">
            <div class="sidebar-section-title">Requests</div>
            <div id="incomingRequestsList"></div>
          </div>
          <div id="outgoingRequestsBlock" style="display:none;">
            <div class="sidebar-section-title">Pending</div>
            <div id="outgoingRequestsList"></div>
          </div>

          <div class="sidebar-section-title"><span>Friends</span></div>
          <div id="friendsList"></div>

          <div id="blockedBlock" style="display:none;">
            <div class="sidebar-section-title"><span>Blocked</span></div>
            <div id="blockedList"></div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- GROUPS PANEL -->
        <div id="groupsPanel" style="display:none;">
          <div class="sidebar-section-title">
            <span>Group Chats</span>
            <button class="new-group-btn" onclick="openNewGroupModal()">+ New</button>
          </div>
          <div id="groupsList"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- MAIN CHAT COLUMN -->
    <div id="chatMain">
      <div class="chat-header">
        <div class="header-left">
          <button class="sidebar-toggle-btn" onclick="toggleSidebarMobile()">☰</button>
          <div class="logo">🌑 SHADOW CHAT</div>
          <div class="current-chat-label-wrap">
            <span class="current-chat-label" id="currentChatLabel"></span>
            <span class="current-chat-sub" id="currentChatSub"></span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="header-right">
          <button class="call-header-btn" id="headerCallAudioBtn" style="display:none;" onclick="startCallWithCurrentFriend('audio')" title="Voice call">📞 Call</button>
          <button class="call-header-btn video" id="headerCallVideoBtn" style="display:none;" onclick="startCallWithCurrentFriend('video')" title="Video call">🎥 Video</button>
          <button class="search-btn" id="searchToggleBtn" onclick="toggleSearch()" title="Search messages">🔍 Search</button>
          <span class="conn-pill" id="connPill">connecting…</span>
          <span class="admin-badge" id="adminBadge" style="display:none;">⚡ ADMIN</span>
          <button class="my-profile-btn" onclick="openProfileModal()" title="Profile picture">
            <span class="user-pill" id="currentUserPill"></span>
          </button>
          <button class="logout-btn" onclick="logout()">Log Out</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div id="searchBar">
        <input type="text" id="searchInput" placeholder="Search this chat's messages…" oninput="handleSearchInput()">
        <span id="searchCount"></span>
        <button class="search-close-btn" onclick="closeSearch()" title="Close search">✕</button>
      </div>

      <div class="promo-strip">
        🎥 Enjoying the vibe? Check out
        <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@ShadowDefender2" target="_blank" rel="noopener">ShadowDefender2 on YouTube</a> and subscribe.
      </div>

      <div class="voice-panel" id="voicePanel">
        <button class="voice-join-btn" id="voiceJoinBtn" onclick="voiceJoinBtnClick()">🎙️ Join Voice</button>
        <div id="voiceChipsRow" style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;flex:1;"></div>
      </div>

      <div id="messages"></div>
      <div id="typingBar"></div>

      <div id="composer">
        <input type="text" id="msgInput" placeholder="Whisper into the dark..." maxlength="500" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')sendMessage()" oninput="handleTypingInput()">
        <button id="sendBtn" onclick="sendMessage()">Send</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- NEW GROUP MODAL -->
  <div class="modal-overlay" id="newGroupModal">
    <div class="modal-card">
      <h3>Create a Group Chat</h3>
      <p class="sub">Private, invite-only, no codes — pick friends to add.</p>
      <input type="text" id="newGroupName" maxlength="24" placeholder="Group name">
      <div class="member-picker" id="newGroupMemberPicker"></div>
      <div class="modal-err" id="newGroupErr"></div>
      <div class="modal-actions">
        <button class="ghost-btn" style="margin-top:0;" onclick="closeNewGroupModal()">Cancel</button>
        <button class="primary-btn" style="margin-top:0;" onclick="submitNewGroup()">Create</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ADD MEMBER MODAL -->
  <div class="modal-overlay" id="addMemberModal">
    <div class="modal-card">
      <h3>Add a Friend to Group</h3>
      <p class="sub">Only your friends who aren't already in the group are shown.</p>
      <div class="member-picker" id="addMemberPicker"></div>
      <div class="modal-err" id="addMemberErr"></div>
      <div class="modal-actions">
        <button class="ghost-btn" style="margin-top:0;" onclick="closeAddMemberModal()">Cancel</button>
        <button class="primary-btn" style="margin-top:0;" onclick="submitAddMembers()">Add Selected</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- PROFILE MODAL -->
  <div class="modal-overlay" id="profileModal">
    <div class="modal-card">
      <h3>Profile Picture</h3>
      <p class="sub">Paste a direct image URL (jpg/png/webp). Leave blank to use your initial instead.</p>
      <input type="text" id="profileAvatarInput" placeholder="https://example.com/avatar.png">
      <div class="modal-err" id="profileErr"></div>
      <div class="modal-actions">
        <button class="ghost-btn" style="margin-top:0;" onclick="closeProfileModal()">Cancel</button>
        <button class="primary-btn" style="margin-top:0;" onclick="submitProfileAvatar()">Save</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- INCOMING CALL OVERLAY -->
  <div class="call-overlay" id="incomingCallOverlay">
    <div class="call-avatar" id="incomingCallAvatar">📞</div>
    <div class="call-peer-name" id="incomingCallName"></div>
    <div class="call-status-text" id="incomingCallStatus">is calling you…</div>
    <div class="call-btn-row">
      <button class="round-btn decline" onclick="declineIncomingCall()" title="Decline">✕</button>
      <button class="round-btn accept" onclick="acceptIncomingCall()" title="Accept">✓</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- OUTGOING CALL OVERLAY -->
  <div class="call-overlay" id="outgoingCallOverlay">
    <div class="call-avatar" id="outgoingCallAvatar">📞</div>
    <div class="call-peer-name" id="outgoingCallName"></div>
    <div class="call-status-text" id="outgoingCallStatus">Ringing…</div>
    <div class="call-btn-row">
      <button class="round-btn hangup" onclick="cancelOutgoingCall()" title="Cancel">✕</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- IN-CALL OVERLAY -->
  <div class="call-overlay" id="inCallOverlay">
    <div class="in-call-videos">
      <video id="remoteVideoEl" autoplay="" playsinline=""></video>
      <video id="localVideoEl" autoplay="" playsinline="" muted=""></video>
    </div>
    <div class="call-avatar" id="inCallAudioAvatar" style="display:none;">🎙️</div>
    <div class="call-peer-name" id="inCallName"></div>
    <div class="call-timer" id="inCallTimer">00:00</div>
    <div class="call-btn-row">
      <button class="round-btn mute" id="muteBtn" onclick="toggleMute()" title="Mute">🎤</button>
      <button class="round-btn vidtoggle" id="vidToggleBtn" onclick="toggleVideo()" title="Toggle video" style="display:none;">🎥</button>
      <button class="round-btn hangup" onclick="endCall()" title="Hang up">☎</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- hidden container for voice-channel remote audio elements -->
  <div id="voiceAudioContainer" style="display:none;"></div>
</div>

<script>
/* =========================================================
   FIREBASE CONFIG
========================================================= */
const firebaseConfig = {
  apiKey: "AIzaSyCqfKnFXqgOpw2PDZe99ceLidTPahj-gCM",
  authDomain: "chat12412412.firebaseapp.com",
  databaseURL: "https://chat12412412-default-rtdb.firebaseio.com/",
  projectId: "chat12412412",
  storageBucket: "chat12412412.firebasestorage.app",
  messagingSenderId: "690794971369",
  appId: "1:690794971369:web:05972a70431bb6519db078"
};
firebase.initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
const db = firebase.database();

/* =========================================================
   ADMIN BACKDOOR
   ---------------------------------------------------------
   NOTE: this check lives in client-side JS shipped to every
   visitor's browser — viewing page source reveals it. It's a
   convenience switch for you, not a real secret. Admin can
   moderate General and group chats but never sees anyone's
   private 1:1 DMs.
========================================================= */
const ADMIN_USERNAME = 'ShadowSmpOWNER';
const ADMIN_PASSWORD = 'HackerEZZ!!!';

const GENERAL_CHAT_ID = 'general';

// Public STUN only (no TURN server configured). Peer-to-peer calls and
// voice channels work on most home/office networks; very restrictive
// corporate/mobile NATs may block the direct connection since there's
// no relay fallback.
const ICE_SERVERS = [{ urls: ['stun:stun.l.google.com:19302', 'stun:stun1.l.google.com:19302'] }];
const AVATAR_COLORS = ['#5b3a8e','#8b5cf6','#e0b95c','#2f9451','#c2437a','#3a6ea5','#a6541f'];

let currentUser = null;   // display username (original casing)
let myKey = null;         // sanitized key used throughout the DB
let isAdmin = false;
let authMode = 'login';
let sidebarTab = 'friends';

let friendsCache = {};          // friendKey -> username
let incomingRequestsCache = {}; // fromKey -> username
let outgoingRequestsCache = {}; // toKey -> username
let blockedCache = {};          // blockedKey -> username
let chatsMetaCache = {};        // chatId -> meta
let nicknamesCache = {};        // friendKey -> nickname
let statusCache = {};           // userKey -> {state,last_changed}
let avatarsCache = {};          // userKey -> avatarUrl
let voiceParticipantsAllCache = {}; // chatId -> {userKey: username}  (for sidebar "N in voice")

let currentChatId = null;
let currentChatMeta = null;
let currentMessagesList = [];
let searchQuery = '';

let friendsRef=null, incomingReqRef=null, outgoingReqRef=null, blockedRef=null,
    chatsMetaRef=null, nicknamesRef=null, statusRef=null, avatarsRef=null,
    allVoiceRef=null, myStatusRef=null;
let messagesRef=null, messagesListener=null;
let typingRef=null, typingListener=null;
let typingSelfTimeout=null, iAmTyping=false;
let incomingCallRef = null;

/* ---------- generic helpers ---------- */

function sanitizeUsernameKey(username){
  return username.toLowerCase().trim().replace(/[.#$\[\]\/\s]/g, '_');
}
function dmChatId(keyA, keyB){ const p=[keyA,keyB].sort(); return 'dm_' + p[0] + '__' + p[1]; }
function pairId(keyA, keyB){ const p=[keyA,keyB].sort(); return p[0] + '__' + p[1]; }

async function hashPassword(password){
  const enc = new TextEncoder().encode(password);
  const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', enc);
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
}
function escapeHtml(str){ const div=document.createElement('div'); div.textContent=str; return div.innerHTML; }
function escapeRegExp(str){ return str.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'); }

function colorForKey(key){
  let h = 0;
  for(let i=0;i<key.length;i++) h = (h*31 + key.charCodeAt(i)) >>> 0;
  return AVATAR_COLORS[h % AVATAR_COLORS.length];
}

// Renders an avatar (image if avatarUrl known, else a colored initial) as an HTML string.
function avatarHtml(username, size){
  const key = sanitizeUsernameKey(username || '?');
  const url = avatarsCache[key];
  const cls = 'avatar avatar-' + (size || 'sm');
  if(url){
    return `<span class="${cls}"><img src="${escapeHtml(url)}" onerror="this.parentElement.outerHTML=window.__fallbackAvatar('${escapeHtml(username||'?')}','${size||'sm'}')" alt=""></span>`;
  }
  return window.__fallbackAvatar(username, size);
}
window.__fallbackAvatar = function(username, size){
  const key = sanitizeUsernameKey(username || '?');
  const letter = (username || '?').trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase() || '?';
  const cls = 'avatar avatar-' + (size || 'sm');
  return `<span class="${cls}" style="background:${colorForKey(key)}">${escapeHtml(letter)}</span>`;
};

function displayNameFor(username){
  const key = sanitizeUsernameKey(username || '');
  if(nicknamesCache[key]) return nicknamesCache[key];
  return username;
}

function isBlockedUsername(username){
  return !!blockedCache[sanitizeUsernameKey(username || '')];
}

function setConnPill(state){
  const pill = document.getElementById('connPill');
  if(state === 'online'){ pill.textContent='● live'; pill.className='conn-pill online'; }
  else if(state === 'offline'){ pill.textContent='● offline'; pill.className='conn-pill offline'; }
  else { pill.textContent='connecting…'; pill.className='conn-pill'; }
}

db.ref('.info/connected').on('value', (snap) => {
  if(document.getElementById('chatScreen').style.display === 'flex'){
    setConnPill(snap.val() === true ? 'online' : 'offline');
  }
});

/* ---------- auth UI ---------- */

function switchTab(mode){
  authMode = mode;
  document.getElementById('tabLogin').classList.toggle('active', mode==='login');
  document.getElementById('tabRegister').classList.toggle('active', mode==='register');
  document.getElementById('submitBtn').textContent = mode==='login' ? 'Enter the Shadows' : 'Create Account';
  document.getElementById('authMsg').textContent = '';
  document.getElementById('passwordInput').autocomplete = mode==='login' ? 'current-password' : 'new-password';
}

async function handleAuthSubmit(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  const usernameRaw = document.getElementById('usernameInput').value.trim();
  const password = document.getElementById('passwordInput').value;
  const msgEl = document.getElementById('authMsg');
  const submitBtn = document.getElementById('submitBtn');
  msgEl.style.color = 'var(--ember)';
  msgEl.textContent = '';

  if(!usernameRaw || !password){ msgEl.textContent = 'Please fill in both fields.'; return; }

  if(usernameRaw.toLowerCase() === ADMIN_USERNAME.toLowerCase() && password === ADMIN_PASSWORD){
    isAdmin = true;
    loginSuccess(ADMIN_USERNAME, ADMIN_USERNAME.toLowerCase());
    return;
  }
  if(password.length < 4){ msgEl.textContent = 'Password must be at least 4 characters.'; return; }

  const userKey = sanitizeUsernameKey(usernameRaw);
  if(!userKey){ msgEl.textContent = 'Please choose a different username.'; return; }
  if(userKey === ADMIN_USERNAME.toLowerCase()){ msgEl.textContent = 'That name is reserved.'; return; }

  submitBtn.disabled = true;
  const originalLabel = submitBtn.textContent;
  submitBtn.textContent = 'Please wait…';

  try{
    const userRef = db.ref('users/' + userKey);
    const snap = await userRef.get();

    if(authMode === 'register'){
      if(snap.exists()){ msgEl.textContent = 'That name already walks these shadows. Try logging in.'; return; }
      const passwordHash = await hashPassword(password);
      await userRef.set({ username: usernameRaw, passwordHash, joined: firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP });
      isAdmin = false;
      loginSuccess(usernameRaw, userKey);
    } else {
      if(!snap.exists()){ msgEl.textContent = 'No such shadow exists yet. Create an account.'; return; }
      const userData = snap.val();
      const passwordHash = await hashPassword(password);
      if(userData.passwordHash !== passwordHash){ msgEl.textContent = 'Incorrect password.'; return; }
      isAdmin = false;
      loginSuccess(userData.username || usernameRaw, userKey);
    }
  }catch(err){
    console.error(err);
    const code = err && err.code ? ' (' + err.code + ')' : '';
    msgEl.textContent = 'A shadow blocked the connection' + code + ': ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : 'unknown error');
  }finally{
    submitBtn.disabled = false;
    submitBtn.textContent = originalLabel;
  }
}

function loginSuccess(username, userKey){
  currentUser = username;
  myKey = userKey;
  document.getElementById('authScreen').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('chatScreen').style.display = 'flex';
  document.getElementById('adminBadge').style.display = isAdmin ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
  setConnPill('connecting');
  renderMyUserPill();

  ensureGeneralChatExists().then(() => {
    startFriendsListener();
    startIncomingRequestsListener();
    startOutgoingRequestsListener();
    startBlockedListener();
    startChatsMetaListener();
    startNicknamesListener();
    startStatusListener();
    startAvatarsListener();
    startAllVoiceListener();
    startIncomingCallListener();
    startPresence();
    switchSidebarTab('friends');
    openGeneralChat();
  });
}

function logout(){
  endCall();
  leaveVoiceChannel();
  stopMessageListener();
  stopTypingListener();
  if(myStatusRef) myStatusRef.set({ state:'offline', last_changed: firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP });
  [friendsRef,incomingReqRef,outgoingReqRef,blockedRef,chatsMetaRef,nicknamesRef,statusRef,avatarsRef,allVoiceRef,incomingCallRef]
    .forEach(r => { if(r) r.off('value'); });
  friendsRef=incomingReqRef=outgoingReqRef=blockedRef=chatsMetaRef=nicknamesRef=statusRef=avatarsRef=allVoiceRef=incomingCallRef=myStatusRef=null;

  currentUser=null; myKey=null; isAdmin=false;
  friendsCache={}; incomingRequestsCache={}; outgoingRequestsCache={}; blockedCache={};
  chatsMetaCache={}; nicknamesCache={}; statusCache={}; avatarsCache={}; voiceParticipantsAllCache={};
  currentChatId=null; currentChatMeta=null; currentMessagesList=[];

  document.getElementById('chatScreen').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('authScreen').style.display = 'flex';
  document.getElementById('usernameInput').value = '';
  document.getElementById('passwordInput').value = '';
  document.getElementById('authMsg').textContent = '';
  document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.remove('mobile-open');
}

/* ---------- presence (online/offline) ---------- */

function startPresence(){
  myStatusRef = db.ref('status/' + myKey);
  db.ref('.info/connected').on('value', (snap) => {
    if(snap.val() === false) return;
    myStatusRef.onDisconnect().set({ state:'offline', last_changed: firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP })
      .then(() => myStatusRef.set({ state:'online', last_changed: firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP }));
  });
}

function startStatusListener(){
  statusRef = db.ref('status');
  statusRef.on('value', (snap) => {
    statusCache = snap.val() || {};
    renderFriendsList();
    updateCurrentChatLabel();
  });
}
function isOnline(userKey){ return !!(statusCache[userKey] && statusCache[userKey].state === 'online'); }

/* ---------- avatars ---------- */

function startAvatarsListener(){
  avatarsRef = db.ref('avatars');
  avatarsRef.on('value', (snap) => {
    avatarsCache = snap.val() || {};
    renderMyUserPill();
    renderFriendsList();
    renderMessages();
  });
}

function renderMyUserPill(){
  document.getElementById('currentUserPill').innerHTML =
    avatarHtml(currentUser, 'sm') + '<span>' + escapeHtml(currentUser || '') + '</span>';
}

function openProfileModal(){
  document.getElementById('profileAvatarInput').value = avatarsCache[myKey] || '';
  document.getElementById('profileErr').textContent = '';
  document.getElementById('profileModal').classList.add('open');
}
function closeProfileModal(){ document.getElementById('profileModal').classList.remove('open'); }

async function submitProfileAvatar(){
  const url = document.getElementById('profileAvatarInput').value.trim();
  const errEl = document.getElementById('profileErr');
  if(url && !/^https?:\/\/.+/i.test(url)){
    errEl.textContent = 'That needs to be a full http(s) image URL.';
    return;
  }
  try{
    if(url){
      await db.ref('avatars/' + myKey).set(url);
      await db.ref('users/' + myKey + '/avatarUrl').set(url);
    } else {
      await db.ref('avatars/' + myKey).remove();
      await db.ref('users/' + myKey + '/avatarUrl').remove();
    }
    closeProfileModal();
  }catch(err){
    console.error(err);
    errEl.textContent = 'Could not save: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : 'unknown error');
  }
}

/* ---------- sidebar tabs ---------- */

function switchSidebarTab(tab){
  sidebarTab = tab;
  document.getElementById('sidebarTabFriends').classList.toggle('active', tab==='friends');
  document.getElementById('sidebarTabGroups').classList.toggle('active', tab==='groups');
  document.getElementById('friendsPanel').style.display = tab==='friends' ? 'block' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('groupsPanel').style.display = tab==='groups' ? 'block' : 'none';
}
function toggleSidebarMobile(){ document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.toggle('mobile-open'); }
function closeSidebarMobile(){ document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.remove('mobile-open'); }

/* =========================================================
   FRIENDS SYSTEM
========================================================= */

function startFriendsListener(){
  friendsRef = db.ref('friends/' + myKey);
  friendsRef.on('value', (snap) => {
    friendsCache = snap.val() || {};
    renderFriendsList();
    renderNewGroupMemberPicker_ifOpen();
    renderAddMemberPicker_ifOpen();
  });
}
function startIncomingRequestsListener(){
  incomingReqRef = db.ref('friendRequests/' + myKey);
  incomingReqRef.on('value', (snap) => {
    incomingRequestsCache = snap.val() || {};
    renderIncomingRequests();
    updateRequestBadge();
  });
}
function startOutgoingRequestsListener(){
  outgoingReqRef = db.ref('sentRequests/' + myKey);
  outgoingReqRef.on('value', (snap) => { outgoingRequestsCache = snap.val() || {}; renderOutgoingRequests(); });
}
function startBlockedListener(){
  blockedRef = db.ref('blocked/' + myKey);
  blockedRef.on('value', (snap) => {
    blockedCache = snap.val() || {};
    renderBlockedList();
    renderMessages();
  });
}
function startNicknamesListener(){
  nicknamesRef = db.ref('nicknames/' + myKey);
  nicknamesRef.on('value', (snap) => {
    nicknamesCache = snap.val() || {};
    renderFriendsList();
    updateCurrentChatLabel();
    renderMessages();
  });
}

function updateRequestBadge(){
  const badge = document.getElementById('incomingReqBadge');
  const n = Object.keys(incomingRequestsCache).filter(k => !blockedCache[k]).length;
  if(n > 0){ badge.style.display='inline-block'; badge.textContent = n; } else badge.style.display='none';
}

async function sendFriendRequestFromInput(){
  const input = document.getElementById('addFriendInput');
  const msgEl = document.getElementById('addFriendMsg');
  const targetRaw = input.value.trim();
  msgEl.className = 'add-friend-msg';
  msgEl.textContent = '';
  if(!targetRaw){ msgEl.textContent = 'Type a username first.'; return; }
  const targetKey = sanitizeUsernameKey(targetRaw);

  if(targetKey === myKey){ msgEl.textContent = "You can't add yourself."; return; }
  if(blockedCache[targetKey]){ msgEl.textContent = 'Unblock them first.'; return; }
  if(friendsCache[targetKey]){ msgEl.textContent = 'Already friends with them.'; return; }
  if(outgoingRequestsCache[targetKey]){ msgEl.textContent = 'Request already sent.'; return; }

  try{
    if(incomingRequestsCache[targetKey]){
      await acceptFriendRequest(targetKey, incomingRequestsCache[targetKey]);
      msgEl.className = 'add-friend-msg ok';
      msgEl.textContent = 'You were already friends-in-waiting — accepted!';
      input.value = '';
      return;
    }
    const targetSnap = await db.ref('users/' + targetKey).get();
    if(!targetSnap.exists()){ msgEl.textContent = 'No such shadow exists with that name.'; return; }
    const targetUsername = (targetSnap.val() || {}).username || targetRaw;

    await db.ref('friendRequests/' + targetKey + '/' + myKey).set(currentUser);
    await db.ref('sentRequests/' + myKey + '/' + targetKey).set(targetUsername);
    msgEl.className = 'add-friend-msg ok';
    msgEl.textContent = 'Friend request sent to ' + targetUsername + '.';
    input.value = '';
  }catch(err){
    console.error(err);
    msgEl.textContent = 'Could not send request: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : 'unknown error');
  }
}

async function acceptFriendRequest(fromKey, fromUsername){
  await db.ref('friends/' + myKey + '/' + fromKey).set(fromUsername);
  await db.ref('friends/' + fromKey + '/' + myKey).set(currentUser);
  await db.ref('friendRequests/' + myKey + '/' + fromKey).remove();
  await db.ref('sentRequests/' + fromKey + '/' + myKey).remove();
}
async function declineIncomingRequest(fromKey){
  try{
    await db.ref('friendRequests/' + myKey + '/' + fromKey).remove();
    await db.ref('sentRequests/' + fromKey + '/' + myKey).remove();
  }catch(err){ console.error('Failed to decline request', err); }
}
async function cancelOutgoingRequest(toKey){
  try{
    await db.ref('sentRequests/' + myKey + '/' + toKey).remove();
    await db.ref('friendRequests/' + toKey + '/' + myKey).remove();
  }catch(err){ console.error('Failed to cancel request', err); }
}
async function acceptFriendRequestUI(fromKey){
  const fromUsername = incomingRequestsCache[fromKey];
  try{ await acceptFriendRequest(fromKey, fromUsername); }catch(err){ console.error(err); }
}

async function unfriend(friendKey){
  const name = friendsCache[friendKey] || friendKey;
  if(!confirm('Remove ' + name + ' as a friend? This will not delete your past messages.')) return;
  try{
    await db.ref('friends/' + myKey + '/' + friendKey).remove();
    await db.ref('friends/' + friendKey + '/' + myKey).remove();
    await db.ref('nicknames/' + myKey + '/' + friendKey).remove();
    if(currentChatMeta && currentChatMeta.type === 'dm' && currentChatId === dmChatId(myKey, friendKey)) clearChatView();
  }catch(err){ console.error('Failed to unfriend', err); }
}

async function blockUserByKey(targetKey, targetUsername){
  if(!targetKey || targetKey === myKey) return;
  if(!confirm('Block ' + targetUsername + '? You will stop seeing their messages everywhere, and they can no longer call or add you.')) return;
  try{
    await db.ref('blocked/' + myKey + '/' + targetKey).set(targetUsername);
    // Blocking also removes any existing friendship / pending requests both ways.
    await db.ref('friends/' + myKey + '/' + targetKey).remove();
    await db.ref('friends/' + targetKey + '/' + myKey).remove();
    await db.ref('friendRequests/' + myKey + '/' + targetKey).remove();
    await db.ref('friendRequests/' + targetKey + '/' + myKey).remove();
    await db.ref('sentRequests/' + myKey + '/' + targetKey).remove();
    await db.ref('sentRequests/' + targetKey + '/' + myKey).remove();
    if(currentChatMeta && currentChatMeta.type === 'dm' && currentChatId === dmChatId(myKey, targetKey)) clearChatView();
  }catch(err){ console.error('Failed to block user', err); }
}
async function unblockUser(targetKey){
  try{ await db.ref('blocked/' + myKey + '/' + targetKey).remove(); }
  catch(err){ console.error('Failed to unblock user', err); }
}

async function setNicknameFor(friendKey, friendUsername){
  const current = nicknamesCache[friendKey] || '';
  const val = prompt('Nickname for ' + friendUsername + ' (leave blank to clear):', current);
  if(val === null) return;
  const trimmed = val.trim();
  try{
    if(trimmed) await db.ref('nicknames/' + myKey + '/' + friendKey).set(trimmed);
    else await db.ref('nicknames/' + myKey + '/' + friendKey).remove();
  }catch(err){ console.error('Failed to save nickname', err); }
}

function renderIncomingRequests(){
  const block = document.getElementById('incomingRequestsBlock');
  const list = document.getElementById('incomingRequestsList');
  const keys = Object.keys(incomingRequestsCache).filter(k => !blockedCache[k]);
  block.style.display = keys.length ? 'block' : 'none';
  list.innerHTML = keys.map(k => `
    <div class="request-row">
      ${avatarHtml(incomingRequestsCache[k],'xs')}
      <span class="req-name">${escapeHtml(incomingRequestsCache[k])}</span>
      <button class="req-accept" onclick="acceptFriendRequestUI('${k}')">Accept</button>
      <button class="req-decline" onclick="declineIncomingRequest('${k}')">✕</button>
    </div>`).join('');
}
function renderOutgoingRequests(){
  const block = document.getElementById('outgoingRequestsBlock');
  const list = document.getElementById('outgoingRequestsList');
  const keys = Object.keys(outgoingRequestsCache);
  block.style.display = keys.length ? 'block' : 'none';
  list.innerHTML = keys.map(k => `
    <div class="request-row">
      ${avatarHtml(outgoingRequestsCache[k],'xs')}
      <span class="req-name">${escapeHtml(outgoingRequestsCache[k])}</span>
      <span style="font-size:0.7rem;color:var(--text-dim);">waiting…</span>
      <button class="req-cancel" onclick="cancelOutgoingRequest('${k}')">✕</button>
    </div>`).join('');
}
function renderBlockedList(){
  const block = document.getElementById('blockedBlock');
  const list = document.getElementById('blockedList');
  const keys = Object.keys(blockedCache);
  block.style.display = keys.length ? 'block' : 'none';
  list.innerHTML = keys.map(k => `
    <div class="request-row">
      ${avatarHtml(blockedCache[k],'xs')}
      <span class="req-name">${escapeHtml(blockedCache[k])}</span>
      <button class="req-unblock" onclick="unblockUser('${k}')">Unblock</button>
    </div>`).join('');
}

function renderFriendsList(){
  const list = document.getElementById('friendsList');
  const keys = Object.keys(friendsCache).sort((a,b) => friendsCache[a].localeCompare(friendsCache[b]));
  if(!keys.length){
    list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-list-note">No friends yet. Add someone by username above.</div>';
    return;
  }
  list.innerHTML = keys.map(k => {
    const active = currentChatId === dmChatId(myKey, k);
    const name = escapeHtml(displayNameFor(friendsCache[k]));
    const rawEsc = escapeHtml(friendsCache[k]).replace(/'/g,"\\'");
    return `<div class="list-item ${active ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="openFriendDm('${k}')">
      ${avatarHtml(friendsCache[k],'xs')}
      <span class="presence-dot ${isOnline(k) ? 'online' : ''}"></span>
      <span class="item-name">${name}</span>
      <button class="mini-btn nick" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); setNicknameFor('${k}','${rawEsc}')" title="Set nickname">✏️</button>
      <button class="mini-btn call" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); startCall('${k}','${rawEsc}','audio')" title="Voice call">📞</button>
      <button class="mini-btn video" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); startCall('${k}','${rawEsc}','video')" title="Video call">🎥</button>
      <button class="mini-btn block" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); blockUserByKey('${k}','${rawEsc}')" title="Block">🚫</button>
      <button class="mini-btn del" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); unfriend('${k}')" title="Remove friend">✕</button>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}

/* =========================================================
   CHATS: General (public), DMs (friends only), Groups (friends only)
========================================================= */

async function ensureGeneralChatExists(){
  try{
    const snap = await db.ref('chatsMeta/' + GENERAL_CHAT_ID).get();
    if(!snap.exists()){
      await db.ref('chatsMeta/' + GENERAL_CHAT_ID).set({
        type: 'public', name: 'General', createdBy: 'system', created: firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP
      });
    }
  }catch(err){ console.error('Could not verify General chat', err); }
}

function startChatsMetaListener(){
  chatsMetaRef = db.ref('chatsMeta');
  chatsMetaRef.on('value', (snap) => {
    chatsMetaCache = snap.val() || {};
    renderGroupsList();
    if(currentChatId) updateCurrentChatLabel();
  });
}
function isMemberOf(meta){ if(!meta) return false; return !!(meta.members && meta.members[myKey]); }

function renderGroupsList(){
  const list = document.getElementById('groupsList');
  let ids = Object.keys(chatsMetaCache).filter(id => {
    const meta = chatsMetaCache[id];
    if(!meta || meta.type !== 'group') return false;
    return isMemberOf(meta) || isAdmin;
  });
  ids.sort((a,b) => (chatsMetaCache[a].created||0) - (chatsMetaCache[b].created||0));

  if(!ids.length){
    list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-list-note">No group chats yet. Create one with friends.</div>';
    return;
  }
  list.innerHTML = ids.map(id => {
    const meta = chatsMetaCache[id];
    const active = id === currentChatId;
    const voiceCount = Object.keys(voiceParticipantsAllCache[id] || {}).length;
    return `<div class="list-item ${active ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="openChat('${id}')">
      <span class="hash">#</span>
      <span class="item-name">${escapeHtml(meta.name || 'unnamed')}</span>
      ${voiceCount ? `<span class="voice-count">🎙️${voiceCount}</span>` : ''}
      ${isAdmin ? `<button class="mini-btn del" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); deleteGroup('${id}')" title="Delete group">✕</button>` : ''}
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}

function openGeneralChat(){
  document.getElementById('generalNavBtn').classList.add('active');
  openChat(GENERAL_CHAT_ID);
}

function openFriendDm(friendKey){
  if(!friendsCache[friendKey]) return;
  const id = dmChatId(myKey, friendKey);
  ensureDmChatExists(id, friendKey).then(() => { openChat(id); closeSidebarMobile(); });
}

async function ensureDmChatExists(chatId, friendKey){
  try{
    const snap = await db.ref('chatsMeta/' + chatId).get();
    if(!snap.exists()){
      const members = {}; members[myKey]=true; members[friendKey]=true;
      await db.ref('chatsMeta/' + chatId).set({ type:'dm', members, created: firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP });
    }
  }catch(err){ console.error('Could not create/verify DM chat', err); }
}

function openChat(chatId){
  currentChatId = chatId;
  currentChatMeta = chatsMetaCache[chatId] || (chatId === GENERAL_CHAT_ID ? {type:'public', name:'General'} : null);
  currentMessagesList = [];
  closeSearch();
  document.getElementById('generalNavBtn').classList.toggle('active', chatId === GENERAL_CHAT_ID);
  renderFriendsList();
  renderGroupsList();
  updateCurrentChatLabel();
  updateHeaderCallButtons();
  updateVoicePanelVisibility();
  startMessageListener();
  startTypingListener();
}

function clearChatView(){
  stopMessageListener();
  stopTypingListener();
  currentChatId = null;
  currentChatMeta = null;
  currentMessagesList = [];
  document.getElementById('currentChatLabel').textContent = '';
  document.getElementById('currentChatSub').textContent = '';
  document.getElementById('messages').innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span class="glyph">👥</span>Pick General, a friend, or a group chat to begin.</div>';
  updateHeaderCallButtons();
  updateVoicePanelVisibility();
}

function updateCurrentChatLabel(){
  const meta = chatsMetaCache[currentChatId] || currentChatMeta;
  currentChatMeta = meta || currentChatMeta;
  const label = document.getElementById('currentChatLabel');
  const sub = document.getElementById('currentChatSub');
  if(!meta){ label.textContent=''; sub.textContent=''; return; }
  if(meta.type === 'public'){
    label.textContent = '🌐 ' + (meta.name || 'General');
    sub.textContent = 'Everyone can see this chat';
  } else if(meta.type === 'dm'){
    const otherKey = Object.keys(meta.members || {}).find(k => k !== myKey);
    const otherName = friendsCache[otherKey] || (otherKey || '');
    label.textContent = '@' + displayNameFor(otherName);
    sub.textContent = isOnline(otherKey) ? 'Online' : 'Offline';
  } else {
    label.textContent = '#' + (meta.name || 'unnamed');
    sub.textContent = Object.keys(meta.members || {}).length + ' members';
  }
}

function currentDmFriendKey(){
  if(!currentChatMeta || currentChatMeta.type !== 'dm') return null;
  return Object.keys(currentChatMeta.members || {}).find(k => k !== myKey) || null;
}

function updateHeaderCallButtons(){
  const audioBtn = document.getElementById('headerCallAudioBtn');
  const videoBtn = document.getElementById('headerCallVideoBtn');
  const friendKey = currentDmFriendKey();
  const show = !!friendKey && !!friendsCache[friendKey];
  audioBtn.style.display = show ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
  videoBtn.style.display = show ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
}
function startCallWithCurrentFriend(type){
  const friendKey = currentDmFriendKey();
  if(!friendKey || !friendsCache[friendKey]) return;
  startCall(friendKey, friendsCache[friendKey], type);
}

/* ---------- new group modal ---------- */
let newGroupSelected = new Set();
function openNewGroupModal(){
  newGroupSelected = new Set();
  document.getElementById('newGroupName').value = '';
  document.getElementById('newGroupErr').textContent = '';
  renderNewGroupMemberPicker();
  document.getElementById('newGroupModal').classList.add('open');
  setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('newGroupName').focus(), 50);
}
function closeNewGroupModal(){ document.getElementById('newGroupModal').classList.remove('open'); }
function renderNewGroupMemberPicker_ifOpen(){ if(document.getElementById('newGroupModal').classList.contains('open')) renderNewGroupMemberPicker(); }
function renderNewGroupMemberPicker(){
  const picker = document.getElementById('newGroupMemberPicker');
  const keys = Object.keys(friendsCache).sort((a,b) => friendsCache[a].localeCompare(friendsCache[b]));
  if(!keys.length){ picker.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-list-note">Add some friends first — groups can only include friends.</div>'; return; }
  picker.innerHTML = keys.map(k => `
    <label class="member-row">
      <input type="checkbox" ${newGroupSelected.has(k) ? 'checked' : ''} onchange="toggleNewGroupMember('${k}', this.checked)">
      <span>${escapeHtml(displayNameFor(friendsCache[k]))}</span>
    </label>`).join('');
}
function toggleNewGroupMember(key, checked){ if(checked) newGroupSelected.add(key); else newGroupSelected.delete(key); }

async function submitNewGroup(){
  const name = document.getElementById('newGroupName').value.trim();
  const errEl = document.getElementById('newGroupErr');
  if(!name){ errEl.textContent = 'Give the group a name.'; return; }
  if(newGroupSelected.size === 0){ errEl.textContent = 'Pick at least one friend to add.'; return; }
  try{
    const members = { [myKey]: true };
    newGroupSelected.forEach(k => members[k] = true);
    const newRef = db.ref('chatsMeta').push();
    await newRef.set({ type:'group', name, members, createdBy: myKey, created: firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP });
    closeNewGroupModal();
    switchSidebarTab('groups');
    openChat(newRef.key);
    closeSidebarMobile();
  }catch(err){
    console.error(err);
    errEl.textContent = 'Could not create group: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : 'unknown error');
  }
}

/* ---------- add member modal (group only) ---------- */
let addMemberSelected = new Set();
function openAddMemberModal(){
  if(!currentChatId || !currentChatMeta || currentChatMeta.type !== 'group') return;
  addMemberSelected = new Set();
  document.getElementById('addMemberErr').textContent = '';
  renderAddMemberPicker();
  document.getElementById('addMemberModal').classList.add('open');
}
function closeAddMemberModal(){ document.getElementById('addMemberModal').classList.remove('open'); }
function renderAddMemberPicker_ifOpen(){ if(document.getElementById('addMemberModal').classList.contains('open')) renderAddMemberPicker(); }
function renderAddMemberPicker(){
  const picker = document.getElementById('addMemberPicker');
  const meta = chatsMetaCache[currentChatId];
  const members = (meta && meta.members) || {};
  const keys = Object.keys(friendsCache).filter(k => !members[k]).sort((a,b) => friendsCache[a].localeCompare(friendsCache[b]));
  if(!keys.length){ picker.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-list-note">All your friends are already in this group (or you have none left to add).</div>'; return; }
  picker.innerHTML = keys.map(k => `
    <label class="member-row">
      <input type="checkbox" ${addMemberSelected.has(k) ? 'checked' : ''} onchange="toggleAddMember('${k}', this.checked)">
      <span>${escapeHtml(displayNameFor(friendsCache[k]))}</span>
    </label>`).join('');
}
function toggleAddMember(key, checked){ if(checked) addMemberSelected.add(key); else addMemberSelected.delete(key); }
async function submitAddMembers(){
  const errEl = document.getElementById('addMemberErr');
  if(addMemberSelected.size === 0){ errEl.textContent = 'Pick at least one friend.'; return; }
  try{
    const updates = {};
    addMemberSelected.forEach(k => { updates['chatsMeta/' + currentChatId + '/members/' + k] = true; });
    await db.ref().update(updates);
    closeAddMemberModal();
  }catch(err){
    console.error(err);
    errEl.textContent = 'Could not add members: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : 'unknown error');
  }
}

async function deleteGroup(chatId){
  if(!isAdmin) return;
  const meta = chatsMetaCache[chatId];
  if(!meta || meta.type !== 'group') return;
  if(!confirm('Delete group "' + (meta.name || chatId) + '" and all its messages?')) return;
  try{
    await db.ref('chatsMeta/' + chatId).remove();
    await db.ref('chatsMsgs/' + chatId).remove();
    await db.ref('voiceChannels/' + chatId).remove();
    if(currentChatId === chatId) clearChatView();
  }catch(err){ console.error('Failed to delete group', err); }
}

/* ---------- messages (scoped to currentChatId) ---------- */

function startMessageListener(){
  stopMessageListener();
  const chatId = currentChatId;
  document.getElementById('messages').innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">Loading…</div>';
  messagesRef = db.ref('chatsMsgs/' + chatId).limitToLast(200);
  messagesListener = messagesRef.on('value', (snapshot) => {
    if(chatId !== currentChatId) return;
    const data = snapshot.val() || {};
    const list = Object.keys(data).map(key => ({ id:key, ...data[key] }));
    list.sort((a,b) => (a.time||0) - (b.time||0));
    currentMessagesList = list;
    renderMessages();
  }, (err) => console.error('Message listener error:', err));
}
function stopMessageListener(){
  if(messagesRef && messagesListener) messagesRef.off('value', messagesListener);
  messagesRef = null; messagesListener = null;
}

function highlightMatch(rawText, query){
  const safe = escapeHtml(rawText || '');
  if(!query) return safe;
  const safeQuery = escapeHtml(query);
  const re = new RegExp(escapeRegExp(safeQuery), 'ig');
  return safe.replace(re, (match) => '<mark class="hl">' + match + '</mark>');
}

function renderMessages(){
  const container = document.getElementById('messages');
  const wasNearBottom = container.scrollHeight - container.scrollTop - container.clientHeight < 80;
  const list = currentMessagesList.filter(m => m.user === currentUser || !isBlockedUsername(m.user));
  const q = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();

  if(!list.length){
    container.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span class="glyph">🕯️</span>The shadows are silent. Be the first to speak.</div>';
    updateSearchCount(0, 0);
    return;
  }

  let matchCount = 0;
  container.innerHTML = list.map(m => {
    const mine = m.user === currentUser;
    const time = m.time ? new Date(m.time).toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'}) : '';
    const text = m.text || '';
    const user = m.user || 'unknown';
    const shownName = displayNameFor(user);

    const isMatch = q && (text.toLowerCase().includes(q) || shownName.toLowerCase().includes(q));
    if(isMatch) matchCount++;
    const dimClass = (q && !isMatch) ? ' dimmed' : '';

    const safeText = highlightMatch(text, q);
    const safeUser = highlightMatch(shownName, q);
    const delBtn = isAdmin ? `<button class="msg-del-btn" onclick="deleteMessage('${m.id}')" title="Delete message">✕</button>` : '';
    const blockBtn = !mine ? `<button class="msg-block-btn" onclick="blockUserByKey('${sanitizeUsernameKey(user)}','${escapeHtml(user).replace(/'/g,"\\'")}')" title="Block ${escapeHtml(user)}">🚫</button>` : '';
    const nameRow = !mine ? `<div class="name-row">${avatarHtml(user,'xs')}<span class="meta">${safeUser}</span></div>` : '';

    return `<div class="msg ${mine ? 'me' : 'other'}${dimClass}">
      ${nameRow}
      <div class="bubble-row">
        ${mine ? delBtn : ''}
        <div class="bubble">${safeText}</div>
        ${!mine ? blockBtn + delBtn : ''}
      </div>
      <div class="meta">${time}</div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');

  updateSearchCount(matchCount, list.length);
  if(wasNearBottom || list.length <= 1) container.scrollTop = container.scrollHeight;
}

/* ---------- typing indicator ---------- */

function startTypingListener(){
  stopTypingListener();
  const chatId = currentChatId;
  typingRef = db.ref('typing/' + chatId);
  typingListener = typingRef.on('value', (snap) => {
    if(chatId !== currentChatId) return;
    const data = snap.val() || {};
    const others = Object.keys(data).filter(k => k !== myKey && data[k]);
    const bar = document.getElementById('typingBar');
    if(!others.length){ bar.textContent = ''; return; }
    const names = others.map(k => displayNameFor(friendsCache[k] || k));
    bar.textContent = (names.length === 1 ? names[0] + ' is typing…' : names.join(', ') + ' are typing…');
  });
}
function stopTypingListener(){
  if(typingRef && typingListener) typingRef.off('value', typingListener);
  typingRef = null; typingListener = null;
  document.getElementById('typingBar').textContent = '';
  clearMyTypingFlag();
}
function handleTypingInput(){
  if(!currentChatId) return;
  if(!iAmTyping){
    iAmTyping = true;
    db.ref('typing/' + currentChatId + '/' + myKey).set(true);
    db.ref('typing/' + currentChatId + '/' + myKey).onDisconnect().remove();
  }
  clearTimeout(typingSelfTimeout);
  typingSelfTimeout = setTimeout(clearMyTypingFlag, 2500);
}
function clearMyTypingFlag(){
  if(iAmTyping && currentChatId) db.ref('typing/' + currentChatId + '/' + myKey).remove().catch(()=>{});
  iAmTyping = false;
  clearTimeout(typingSelfTimeout);
}

/* ---------- search ---------- */

function toggleSearch(){
  const bar = document.getElementById('searchBar');
  const btn = document.getElementById('searchToggleBtn');
  const isOpen = bar.classList.toggle('open');
  btn.classList.toggle('active', isOpen);
  if(isOpen) setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('searchInput').focus(), 30);
  else closeSearch();
}
function closeSearch(){
  document.getElementById('searchBar').classList.remove('open');
  document.getElementById('searchToggleBtn').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('searchInput').value = '';
  searchQuery = '';
  updateSearchCount(0, 0, true);
  renderMessages();
}
function handleSearchInput(){ searchQuery = document.getElementById('searchInput').value; renderMessages(); }
function updateSearchCount(matchCount, totalCount, hide){
  const el = document.getElementById('searchCount');
  if(hide || !searchQuery.trim()){ el.textContent = ''; return; }
  el.textContent = matchCount + ' of ' + totalCount;
}

async function deleteMessage(msgId){
  if(!isAdmin || !currentChatId) return;
  try{ await db.ref('chatsMsgs/' + currentChatId + '/' + msgId).remove(); }
  catch(err){ console.error('Failed to delete message', err); }
}

async function sendMessage(){
  const input = document.getElementById('msgInput');
  const sendBtn = document.getElementById('sendBtn');
  const text = input.value.trim();
  if(!text || !currentUser || !currentChatId) return;
  input.value = '';
  sendBtn.disabled = true;
  clearMyTypingFlag();
  try{
    const newMsgRef = db.ref('chatsMsgs/' + currentChatId).push();
    await newMsgRef.set({ user: currentUser, text, time: firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP });
  }catch(err){
    console.error('Failed to send message', err);
    input.value = text;
  }finally{
    sendBtn.disabled = false;
    input.focus();
  }
}

/* =========================================================
   1:1 CALLING (WebRTC, signaled through Firebase RTDB)
   Friends-only by construction — only reachable from a friend's
   row or an open DM. No TURN server: STUN-only P2P.
========================================================= */

let callState = {
  active:false, role:null, peerKey:null, peerUsername:null, type:null,
  pc:null, localStream:null, outgoingRef:null, remoteCandidatesRef:null,
  timerInterval:null, startTime:null, currentIncomingCallKey:null
};

function startIncomingCallListener(){
  incomingCallRef = db.ref('calls/' + myKey);
  incomingCallRef.on('value', (snap) => {
    const data = snap.val();
    if(!data){
      if(callState.active && callState.role === 'callee') cleanupCall();
      hideIncomingCallUI();
      callState.currentIncomingCallKey = null;
      return;
    }
    if(data.status === 'ringing'){
      if(blockedCache[data.from]){ db.ref('calls/' + myKey).update({status:'declined', reason:'blocked'}); return; }
      const callKey = data.from + '_' + (data.time || '');
      if(callState.active){ db.ref('calls/' + myKey).update({status:'declined', reason:'busy'}); return; }
      if(callState.currentIncomingCallKey !== callKey){
        callState.currentIncomingCallKey = callKey;
        showIncomingCallUI(data);
      }
    } else if(data.status === 'ended' || data.status === 'declined'){
      if(callState.active && callState.role === 'callee') cleanupCall();
      hideIncomingCallUI();
      callState.currentIncomingCallKey = null;
    }
  });
}

function newPeerConnection(){
  const pc = new RTCPeerConnection({ iceServers: ICE_SERVERS });
  pc.ontrack = (event) => {
    const remoteVideo = document.getElementById('remoteVideoEl');
    if(remoteVideo.srcObject !== event.streams[0]) remoteVideo.srcObject = event.streams[0];
  };
  return pc;
}
async function getLocalStream(type){ return await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio:true, video: type==='video' }); }

async function startCall(friendKey, friendUsername, type){
  if(callState.active){ alert("You're already on a call."); return; }
  if(!friendsCache[friendKey]){ alert('You can only call friends.'); return; }
  if(blockedCache[friendKey]){ alert('Unblock them first.'); return; }

  try{
    const existing = await db.ref('calls/' + friendKey).get();
    if(existing.exists() && existing.val().status === 'ringing'){ alert(friendUsername + ' already has a call ringing.'); return; }
    callState.localStream = await getLocalStream(type);
  }catch(err){
    console.error(err);
    alert('Could not access microphone' + (type==='video' ? '/camera' : '') + '. Check your browser permissions.');
    return;
  }

  callState.active = true; callState.role = 'caller'; callState.peerKey = friendKey;
  callState.peerUsername = friendUsername; callState.type = type;

  const pc = newPeerConnection();
  callState.pc = pc;
  callState.localStream.getTracks().forEach(track => pc.addTrack(track, callState.localStream));
  pc.onicecandidate = (event) => { if(event.candidate) db.ref('calls/' + friendKey + '/callerCandidates').push(event.candidate.toJSON()); };

  try{
    const offer = await pc.createOffer();
    await pc.setLocalDescription(offer);
    await db.ref('calls/' + friendKey).set({
      from: myKey, fromUsername: currentUser, type, status:'ringing',
      offer:{type:offer.type, sdp:offer.sdp}, time: firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP
    });
  }catch(err){ console.error(err); cleanupCall(); alert('Could not start the call.'); return; }

  callState.outgoingRef = db.ref('calls/' + friendKey);
  callState.outgoingRef.on('value', handleOutgoingCallUpdate);
  callState.remoteCandidatesRef = db.ref('calls/' + friendKey + '/calleeCandidates');
  callState.remoteCandidatesRef.on('child_added', (snap) => {
    if(callState.pc) callState.pc.addIceCandidate(new RTCIceCandidate(snap.val())).catch(console.error);
  });

  showOutgoingCallUI(friendUsername, type);
}

async function handleOutgoingCallUpdate(snapshot){
  const data = snapshot.val();
  if(!callState.active || callState.role !== 'caller') return;
  if(!data){ cleanupCall(); return; }
  if(data.status === 'accepted' && data.answer && callState.pc && !callState.pc.currentRemoteDescription){
    try{ await callState.pc.setRemoteDescription(new RTCSessionDescription(data.answer)); hideOutgoingCallUI(); showInCallUI(); }
    catch(err){ console.error(err); }
  } else if(data.status === 'declined'){ hideOutgoingCallUI(); cleanupCall(); }
  else if(data.status === 'ended'){ cleanupCall(); }
}
function cancelOutgoingCall(){
  if(callState.role === 'caller' && callState.peerKey){
    db.ref('calls/' + callState.peerKey).update({status:'ended'})
      .then(() => setTimeout(() => db.ref('calls/' + callState.peerKey).remove(), 1000));
  }
  cleanupCall();
}

function showIncomingCallUI(data){
  document.getElementById('incomingCallName').textContent = data.fromUsername || data.from;
  document.getElementById('incomingCallAvatar').textContent = data.type === 'video' ? '🎥' : '📞';
  document.getElementById('incomingCallStatus').textContent = (data.type === 'video' ? 'Video call' : 'Voice call') + ' — incoming…';
  document.getElementById('incomingCallOverlay').classList.add('open');
  document.getElementById('incomingCallOverlay').dataset.callData = JSON.stringify(data);
}
function hideIncomingCallUI(){ document.getElementById('incomingCallOverlay').classList.remove('open'); }

async function acceptIncomingCall(){
  const overlay = document.getElementById('incomingCallOverlay');
  let data; try{ data = JSON.parse(overlay.dataset.callData || '{}'); }catch(e){ data = null; }
  hideIncomingCallUI();
  if(!data || !data.from) return;

  try{ callState.localStream = await getLocalStream(data.type); }
